import33.served: client_jka_ui_host.hpp case UI_S_STARTLOCALSOUND: words outside int refused; S_StartLocalSoundVolume(handle, fntech3::jka::sound::EngineChannel(channel), fntech3::jka::sound::ListenerVolume(channel)); result 0 (as client-game import 38)
import33.fnFeatures: S_StartLocalSoundVolume; Fn channel rules for the translated engine channel; source and tone classes (local: non-diegetic, dry, unsent, high-pass; self: the listener's own sound with a send to its environment); OpenAL HRTF, limiter and output settings; the legacy mixer
differences: Retail ends in an ERR_DROP on an out-of-range handle while sound runs; fnTech3's backends warn and play nothing.
import33.presentationOpen: Academy plays `play` on the auto channel (Quake III TA on the local-sound channel), so its menu clicks take Fn's self class and a send to the listener's room; whether every UI-module sound should be non-diegetic is left open.
